paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average similarities between the headlines from different seasons

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the average similarity over different time intervals measured in days. The x-axis, labeled "Δ Days", consists of categorical intervals: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The y-axis represents "Avg. similarity (10e-2)" on a linear scale, with values ranging from 1.70 to 1.85; the tick interval is 0.05. There is a single line depicted in blue with circular markers, and it follows a dashed line style. The line shows a decreasing trend, starting near the value of 1.84 for the interval (0,90] and ending at slightly below 1.70 for the interval (360,450]. The plotted values decrease at each subsequent interval, with notable points around 1.73 in (270,360] and 1.72 at interval (180,270].
